events.invitation_text: We're up on the gazebo stage at the Summer Shade Festival — Grant Park's big summer weekend, right in our home park. Catch us Saturday around lunchtime, then the rest of the festival's yours. Bring the crew, find some shade.
events.additional_details: Free, all ages. Bolo Boys play the gazebo stage 12:15–1:00 PM; the festival runs all weekend (Sat–Sun) in Grant Park.

logistics_notes.text: Festival gazebo stage — short 45-min set (12:15–1:00)
Booked verbally — confirm load-in / sound details closer to the date

SUPERSEDED 2026-08-17 — see the schedule-verified notes below. (Was: 'We OPEN the festival; Deep South Wrestling follows immediately — keep energy high.' The energy point still stands; the opening claim did not survive checking.)

Band camp proposed 8/20-8/21 at Tate (Nigel 8/10: 'Jamie and I are both free 20 and 21 next week... two days of bandcamp leading up to the summer shade festival') — the two days before this show. Nigel already at Tate Sun-Tue and can extend; John 'Hell yes! Checking on one thing.' NOT yet a confirmed plan.
No poster/graphic yet — poster_url is null. Paul 2026-08-11 wants a Summer Shade graphic before the official announce push.
ARRIVE 11:00 AM — Don's instruction is 1 hour before posted start time; the festival's music page posts us at 12:00.
Load-in / drop-off: corner of Berne St. and Park Ave, at the Grant Park POOL entrance.
Parking: 2 passes per band, free, in the Boulevard Parking deck. Only two — carpool.
BACKLINE PROVIDED on both stages: 2 guitar amps (a Fender plus another Fender-style combo), a bass rig, and a drum kit. Guitarists may bring their own amp if they prefer.
JAMEY BRINGS: snare, cymbals, sticks, drum key. The house kit cannot be struck; organizer describes it as a pro-style kit.
Changeovers are quick — a fast line check per band, no soundcheck. Any unusual sound request goes to Don in advance so he can forward it to the sound crew.

Source: the organizer's performer instructions, sent by Don 2026-08-16 and forwarded by Paul into the band group text. Decoded from iMessage; two copies in the DB agree body-for-body. Don's phone is in bolo-private venue-contacts.json, never here (this file is public).
Gate 1 (Berne St & Park Ave) is the load-in gate on the festival map, and it is the CLOSEST gate to the gazebo stage — both are at the west end of the park. The pool sits just inside it.
Deep South Wrestling is staged directly beside the gazebo stage on the map, which is how we end up opening for a wrestling crowd.

⚠️ PARKING DECK NAME DISAGREES: Don's text says the passes are for the 'Boulevard Parking deck'; the festival map labels the deck at the park's edge 'Gateway Parking Deck'. Probably the same structure — the Conservancy's own venue there is 'Boulevard Green at Gateway Park' — but with only two passes, worth one text to Don rather than finding out Saturday at 11.
Festival map stored at bolo-private/design-sources/summer-shade-2026-festival-map.png.
SCHEDULE VERIFIED 2026-08-17 off summershadefestival.org/music: Bolo Boys are the FIRST act on the Gazebo Stage — the first music that stage sees all weekend. Gazebo Saturday then runs to 6:45 PM.

⚠️ WE DO NOT OPEN THE FESTIVAL, and the prior 'we OPEN the festival' note overstated it. Main Stage Saturday starts 11:00-11:40 with a yoga session, and Yes Ma'am Band plays Main Stage 12:00-12:40 — the same slot as us. There is also a 5K that morning. True claim: first band on the Gazebo Stage, in the festival's opening band slot alongside one other act.
Deep South Wrestling takes the SAME gazebo stage right after us, 1:00-1:30 PM (we end 12:45).
Festival is Aug 22-23 2026, free, all ages, presented by and benefiting the Grant Park Conservancy (gpconservancy.org). Full lineup: summershadefestival.org.

open_questions.text: Set time: the festival's music page publishes 'Bolo Boys | 12:00pm - 12:45 pm'; events.json says 12:15-1:00. NOT AN ISSUE -- Paul 2026-08-11: 'we will be there and ready to play forty five minutes regardless of when exactly we go on.' Recorded so the difference is not rediscovered as news; the 45-minute set is the constant. Leave both as-is unless the organizer says otherwise.

Three Little Birds vs I Shot the Sheriff — Jamey 2026-08-11: 'Personally I would rather play something like Shot the Sheriff instead of Three Little Birds, but that's my only note'. Nigel same day: 'i'm not sure about the moody/mellow marley tunes.' Two of four want the Marley slot changed; not yet decided.
Padding extras not named (45-min slot, 13 songs proposed)
Boys Don't Cry — Jamey 2026-08-11 asked to rehearse it: 'That threw me for a loop when we jumped into it last time at SS'. Covered by band camp 8/20-21 if that lands.

events.invitation_text: We're headed north for the Jasper ArtWalk — our first time playing the mountains, on the courthouse square in the middle of downtown. Art, makers, and music up and down the street all afternoon, and we've got the 2 o'clock slot. Come spend a Saturday in the foothills with us.
events.additional_details: Outdoor show on the courthouse square — weather-dependent. Free, all ages. Part of the Jasper ArtWalk; music continues on the square after our set.

logistics_notes.text: BAND BRINGS ITS OWN FULL PA — the square has no house system.
Wrap ~4:40 so the 5-8 PM band can set up. Eric Reinhardt plays filler between acts.
Lineup: all four, incl. Jamey on drums.

open_questions.text: CLOSED 2026-08-11 on Paul's call — the 9/26 date stands and no email to Angela Reinhardt is needed. The press leg had surfaced two Pickens outlets summarising the 2026 ArtWalk dates as May 30 / Sept 12; Paul ruled there is nothing to chase. Resting on his own knowledge of the 7/23 confirmation, NOT on a verified source — the smokesignalsnews fetch returned 429 and the articles' publication YEAR was never read (they most likely describe 2025). Kept as a note rather than deleted so the difference is not rediscovered as news; the blocked URL stays on press-legs.json in case it ever matters.
